description: This file defines the Content class for managing note content within the Notesnook project, including methods for adding, retrieving, updating, deleting, and processing content, as well as handling media attachments and internal links.

classes.name: Content
classes.description: A class for managing note content, including CRUD operations, media handling, and internal link processing within the Notesnook application.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds or updates a content item, handling encryption and post-processing.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a content item by ID, with pre-processing if necessary.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Soft deletes content items by IDs.

methods.name: removeByNoteId
methods.description: Marks content items associated with specific note IDs as deleted.

methods.name: updateByNoteId
methods.description: Updates content items associated with specific note IDs.

methods.name: findByNoteId
methods.description: Finds a content item by note ID.

methods.name: exists
methods.description: Checks if a content item exists by ID.

methods.name: downloadMedia
methods.description: Downloads media attachments for a content item.

methods.name: removeAttachments
methods.description: Removes specified attachments from a content item.

methods.name: preProcess
methods.description: Pre-processes content, including migration and block ID insertion.

methods.name: postProcess
methods.description: Post-processes content, handling internal links and attachments.

methods.name: processLinkedAttachments
methods.description: Synchronizes attachment links with the note.
